About

I’m a Civil Engineering graduate with hands-on training in BIM, architectural visualization, CAD drafting, construction documentation and quantity estimation.

My technical training includes practical exposure to AutoCAD, Revit, 3ds Max, Lumion and V-Ray, along with BIM fundamentals, CAD-to-BIM workflows, architectural modelling, rendering and walkthrough development.

I’m interested in office-based BIM, Revit, construction documentation, architectural visualization and quantity surveying workflows, with a focus on supporting architects, engineers and construction teams through accurate digital models, drawings and project information.
